headerDisplay:
This fork targets Konnected **Alarm Panel Pro** units running **ESPHome** firmware. Each panel is addressed directly by its host/IP (no discovery or provisioning). For each zone, map an ESPHome entity to a HomeKit accessory.

To find a panel's entity ids, open `http://<panel-host>/events` in a browser, or `curl http://<panel-host>/events` — each `event: state` frame includes an `id` like `binary_sensor-front_hall_motion` and `switch-alarm1`.
footerDisplay: Zone state streams live over the ESPHome web server (Server-Sent Events). Switches/sirens are actuated over the ESPHome REST API. See the project DEV.md for details.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name that will appear in your Homebridge log.

name.title: Panel Name
name.description: A friendly name for this panel (used in logs and accessory model names).

host.title: Host / IP
host.description: The panel's ESPHome web server host or IP address. A port may be appended (defaults to 80).

id.title: Panel ID (optional)
id.description: A stable identifier for this panel, used to keep HomeKit accessory identities consistent if the IP changes (e.g. the ESPHome device id). Defaults to the host.

entityId.title: ESPHome Entity ID
entityId.description: The web_server entity id, e.g. 'binary_sensor-front_hall_motion' or 'switch-alarm1'.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name in HomeKit. Falls back to the ESPHome entity name.

invert.title: Invert State
invert.description: Invert the reported binary state (e.g. the firmware reports ON when the contact is closed).

audibleBeep.title: Audible Beep on Change (Security System)
audibleBeep.description: When the Security System is enabled, momentarily sound the beeper when this contact/motion sensor changes.

triggerableModes.title: Triggerable Security Modes (Security System)
triggerableModes.description: When the Security System is enabled, the armed modes in which this sensor may trigger the alarm.

securitySystem.title: Enable HomeKit Security System
securitySystem.description: Expose a plugin-managed HomeKit Security System accessory with arming/disarming logic. When off, zones are exposed as plain sensors and actuators only.

delay.title: Entry Delay (seconds)
delay.description: Time after a triggering sensor changes before the alarm fires. 0 = instant.

delay.title: Exit Delay (seconds)
delay.description: Time after arming before the system becomes active. 0 = instant.

audibleBeeperModes.title: Audible Beeper Modes
audibleBeeperModes.description: Armed modes that play an audible exit countdown on the beeper.
